# Filter the dataframe for 'centru' county
centru_row = df[df['county'].str.lower() == 'centru']

# Extract the relevant percentages as strings, remove spaces and '%' sign, convert to float
export_percent_str = centru_row['percent of total exports'].iloc[0]
import_percent_str = centru_row['percent of total imports'].iloc[0]

export_percent = float(export_percent_str.replace(' ', '').replace('%', ''))
import_percent = float(import_percent_str.replace(' ', '').replace('%', ''))

# Check the claim: exports 13.8% and imports 11.2%
answer = (export_percent == 13.8) and (import_percent == 11.2)
